answer: Because the timing is recorded against the copper challenge, the canyon audit can replay the terrace history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 208 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4665 identities would post 3854 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
